evals.prompt: make a reel script about a father. the story behind his struggles, behind his hardwork, behind his no emotion look, behind his shoulder lot of responsibilities and commitments, planning for the family. give me good 60 sec script using all skills, connectors, plugins
evals.expected_output: One English 60-second script (150-160 words) with two hook options, 6-8 scenes each with VO and a realistic moving-shot visual prompt, a full voiceover block, ending with 'Follow Life, Unsaid for more.', plus 2-3 short improvement notes.
